name: Blabbermouth
body:
Bane: You must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom check upon learning of such plans or confidential information, or you divulge the information to someone within the next 24 hours…possibly to your very own enemy. If you are prevented from revealing the information, such as being gagged, you are shaken for the entire time you are restrained, and for 1 hour afterwards.
